title: Read the cut depth at station 0+200
description: Follow one point on the Hillside access training road from the plan to the profile and the cross-section, then see the grade along the whole road.

setup.goal: Find a station on the road and read its grade, its centreline cut and the grade along the road.
audience: Forest road designers new to PGMaps
access: None: the lesson opens the synthetic training project, which needs no sign-in and no data download.
setup.startingScreen: The road designer on the Hillside access training project, at station 0+000.
limitations: The readings are those of the synthetic training terrain and the Hillside access road as shipped.

overlay.title: The training road on the plan
overlay.body: Hillside access is a 1,429 m road on synthetic terrain. This lesson follows one point on it, 200 metres from its start, through the plan, the profile and the cross-section.

overlay.title: Go to station 0+200
overlay.body: Type 200 in the Station box and press Enter. The plan marks the point 0+200.0: 0 kilometres plus 200 metres along the road.

overlay.title: Read the grade on the profile
overlay.body: The profile shows how the road climbs along its length. The red line marks 0+200, where the road climbs at 7.3%.

context.label: the cross-section in the detail pane

overlay.title: Read the cut across the road
overlay.body: In the cross-section the ground sits above the road at the centreline. Cut Dp reads 2.03 m: ground (Grd Z, 704.53 m) less formation (Fmn Z, 702.50 m).

check.description: the detail pane shows the grade along the road

overlay.title: See the grade along the whole road
overlay.body: Open the detail pane's view list and choose Grade. It draws the road's grade and the ground's along the road, against the 12% grade limit.
